title: PitchFrameBatch
description: One 60 Hz batch of live pitch frames, pushed over the Tauri Channel passed to pitch_subscribe. Mirrors Rust struct audio::pitch::PitchFrameBatch. Mode flags ride on the batch so the UI does not have to wait for pitch://state to learn that a hold started.

frames.description: Pitch frames produced since the previous batch, in arrival order. May be empty when listening is on but nothing has been analysed yet.

deviceRate.description: Capture sample rate of the input that produced these frames. 0 when no stream is open.

listening.description: True while the user has asked for live pitch (listen toggle or open panel).

rehearseHold.description: True while rehearse-hold is down: the take writes silence, analysis keeps running.

pitchFrame.title: PitchFrame
pitchFrame.description: One 10 ms analysis hop. Unvoiced frames are still emitted so the trail breaks on a breath.

sample.description: Transport sample position at the centre of the analysis window, in device-rate samples.

hz.description: Detected fundamental in Hz. Meaningful only when voiced is true.

midi.description: Continuous MIDI note number (69 + 12*log2(hz/440)). Meaningful only when voiced is true.

rms.description: RMS of the analysis window (linear, full scale = 1.0).

voiced.description: True when the detector, RMS gate, median and jump limiter all agree this hop is a note.
